selection: rank best trained tool-choice validation accuracy; serving baseline protected
test_policy: one final selected-serving test per declared child; never select using test
aggregation_policy: single ten-choice window, one forward, no tournament or null choices

balance.method: retain every unique case; classes already balanced

purpose: Train all600 balanced synthetic rows from fresh pinned base per trial; lower-LR validation-only search; no test-guided selection

tracking_notes.searched_parameters: Hyperopt TPE head_lr only; weight_decay0.05 and smoothing0.05 fixed. Singleton categorical spaces preserve existing runner API.
tracking_notes.validation_display: Child val metrics show last epoch; chosen head epoch/validation are in report.json and parent summary.
tracking_notes.comparison: Exploratory new-data and lower-LR training, not a causal data-only comparison. Same v2.1 criteria/seed and heldout bytes. Initial head protected and best-trained head separately preserved.
